subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw permit a model-callable `clear_goal` tool for terminal or paused/limited session goals, and what retained-history contract should it have?
rationale: The request changes a documented model/operator authority boundary and adds durable session history, so code inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Keep operator-only clearing
options.body: Preserve the current contract where models can report `complete` or `blocked`, while clearing/replacement stays with `/goal`, `/new`, and `/reset`; future work could explore non-destructive model requests for operator confirmation.

options.title: Approve terminal-only clear_goal
options.body: Allow a model tool only for a narrowly approved state set, preferably `complete` and `blocked`, and require a bounded canonical `SessionEntry` archive plus docs, mutation metadata, catalog coverage, and live proof.

options.title: Approve broader non-active clearing
options.body: Allow clearing paused and limited goals too, but require explicit retention and operator-boundary language because this changes how stop-like states can be removed.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-only clearing
recommendation.body: Preserve the current contract where models can report `complete` or `blocked`, while clearing/replacement stays with `/goal`, `/new`, and `/reset`; future work could explore non-destructive model requests for operator confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the current core goals feature and public goal-tool contract that this issue proposes to change.
